# A recorded CUBIN with its own nvdisasm listing gives a complete report.
# The listing's encodings equal the image's .text bytes, so the instruction
# features are observed rather than inferred.
unhex $ROUNDTRIP/sm121a-roundtrip.cubin.hex k.cubin
cudainspect report -symbol addk -require target,opcode_histogram,memory_access_widths,precision_attribution -optional feature_suffix -sass $ROUNDTRIP/sm121a-roundtrip.sass $WORK/k.cubin
! stderr .
stdout '"schema_version": 2'
stdout '"result": "complete"'
stdout '"LDG": 2'
stdout '"architecture": "sm_121"'
stdout '"name": "precision_attribution",\s+"state": "observed"'
stdout '"precision": "fp32"'
stdout '"method": "instruction_mix"'
stdout '"share": 1'
stdout 'SASS encodings equal .text.addk bytes'
cp stdout report.json
readreport report.json

# The a suffix comes from the listing's declared target, never from the ELF
# header's SM number.
stdout '"supplied SASS .target sm_121a"'

# An integer-only kernel in the same image has no floating-point or tensor
# precision instructions, so requiring precision_attribution fails the report.
! cudainspect report -symbol intmix -require precision_attribution -sass $ROUNDTRIP/sm121a-roundtrip.sass $WORK/k.cubin
stderr 'cudainspect: required feature unavailable: precision_attribution'
stdout '"result": "failed"'
stdout 'empty instruction mix'
cp stdout intmix.json
readreport intmix.json

# Without the listing, the suffix and the instruction features are unknown
# and null, each with a diagnostic.
cudainspect report -symbol addk $WORK/k.cubin
stdout '"result": "complete"'
stdout '"name": "feature_suffix",\s+"state": "unknown",\s+"value": null'
stdout 'numeric ELF target does not establish a or f suffix features'
stdout '"sass": null'

# Requiring precision_attribution without a SASS listing fails with a validated
# report explaining the missing SASS input.
! cudainspect report -symbol addk -require precision_attribution $WORK/k.cubin
stderr 'cudainspect: required feature unavailable: precision_attribution'
stdout '"name": "precision_attribution",\s+"state": "unknown",\s+"value": null'
stdout 'no SASS supplied'
cp stdout nosass.json
readreport nosass.json
